baseText: THE READER OFFERS A LETTER; THE SENTENCE ANSWERS WITH A GAP.
memoryRule: an offered letter is refused across the entire sentence; every occurrence becomes a structural gap and the remaining glyphs reflow; the latest four refusals are liftable
interactionRule: keyboard letters or the letter strip offer one character; repeated or absent letters refuse without changing geometry; Enter and Space offer the next deterministic letter; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: twelve DOM word islands, pressure bands, and routed letter bodies -> one typographic sentence-sheet whose missing glyphs are actual gaps
encounterRupture: wandering attention, duration hold, and non-local withdrawal -> typed letter offer with immediate sentence-wide refusal
temporalRupture: latent census, pressure debt, and route custody -> bounded refusal stack in which later offers operate on the already mutilated sentence
mediumRupture: semantic DOM islands and Canvas/WEBGL route bodies -> semantic DOM glyph sheet with actual per-character reflow
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
